shortDescription: PRECISION OPTICS CORPORATION, INC. reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $31.5M, up from $19.1M a year earlier, while narrowing its net loss to $3.6M and improving diluted EPS to $(0.43) — reflecting stronger manufacturing volume despite an overall loss for the year.Financial HighlightsBusiness Highlight…

children: PRECISION OPTICS CORPORATION, INC. reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $31.5M, up from $19.1M a year earlier, while narrowing its net loss to $3.6M and improving diluted EPS to $(0.43) — reflecting stronger manufacturing volume despite an overall loss for the year.
Revenue was $31.53M for FY 2026, up from $19.09M in FY 2025; YoY change 65.2%.
Net income was a loss of $3.63M for FY 2026, improved from a loss of $5.78M in FY 2025 (loss narrowed).
Diluted earnings per share was $(0.43) for FY 2026, improved from $(0.85) in FY 2025; improvement 49.4% YoY.
Total revenue growth of 65% to $31.5M was driven primarily by strong Systems Manufacturing volume, which scaled up significantly.
Engineering work shifted to production as the single-use cystoscope moved from development into manufacturing, marking a major channel transition.
Ross Optical sales rose 31.7% and the resumption of deferred customer deliveries boosted order flow.
Systems Manufacturing revenue grew 173% year-over-year, reflecting a significant operational scale-up.
